settings.title: Settings
settings.visibilityHint: Before an accept, only a ~150 m approximate location is ever shared.

safety.title: Safety rules
safety.rule1: Meet first-time runners at public places — park entrances, subway exits.
safety.rule2: Never share personal info like phone numbers. Only approximate locations are shown before an accept.
safety.rule3: If anything feels off, end the run immediately and block/report.
